# Purser

> AI agents spend. You sign off. For CFOs whose AI agents pay suppliers: when an agent wants to pay an invoice over its limit, the CFO signs the exact terms with Face ID. Built for the Airwallex Agentic Banking Hackathon: Starter Kit 11 (x402 Business Agents), entered for the Metal Award and the Visa Award.

Summary: within limits the CFO sets, the agents pay through Airwallex and Metal; above them nothing runs until the CFO's passkey signs a SHA-256 of the exact terms, so changing one cent voids it. Live sandbox and testnet runs show it end to end: 24 Claude decisions, a SWIFT payout carrying the signed hash in Airwallex's own record, Airwallex's card controls and Metal refusing over-limit purchases, a scripted Visa Intelligent Commerce (VIC) purchase via Airwallex's Airi, a connected-account payout with Purser's fee, and the books posted to T:0. Test money only; customers, suppliers and settlement are simulated, and the business model is not yet validated.

Worst case, set by policy: EUR 28,200 on cards and task cards + USD 20 on chain a month. Task cards under a CFO-signed limit: EUR 900 a day. Everything above waits for the CFO. Computed from the policy by exposureOf (src/policy/exposure.ts); the parts are in the README.

Why not Airwallex's own approvals? Purser signs the exact terms with the CFO's passkey before the API call, enforces per-agent limits across Airwallex and Metal, and can additionally require Airwallex's approval workflow (IN_APPROVAL handled, src/airwallex/approvals.ts). Live in the sandbox, 10 and 12 Nov: Airwallex held a payout signed by a labelled test passkey IN_APPROVAL until the owner approved it in Airwallex's web app; then PAID, settlement simulated (docs/runs/2026-11-12-airwallex-two-locks-paid.md).

Hands-on on Purser's real engine, a test company of your own on test money: coming.

Test money only. Live: Claude's decisions, Airwallex sandbox calls, Metal testnet transactions. Simulated: the customer, the supplier, the merchants' charges, the settlement (Purser moves the SWIFT transfer to SENT, then PAID, through the sandbox's simulation API) and the second approver (a labelled test passkey).

## Proofs you can check

- Airwallex: the hash of the exact terms the CFO signed with Face ID is in Airwallex's own record of the EUR 240.00 SWIFT payment, transfer 03360bfa-afce-457b-89d1-e1097fbe3985 (main run, 3 November; settlement simulated in the sandbox): https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/airwallex#awx-hash
- Airwallex: Airwallex's own card controls declined an agent's EUR 45.00 purchase (charge simulated via the sandbox) over its EUR 30.00 limit (LIMIT_EXCEEDED, card transaction 01a1b5e8-6dc2-7000-95bf-c8fc5e6e2f38; the Airwallex-only run, 7 November; 7 of 7 checks): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-07-awx-1.md
- Metal: a mandate on chain per agent; 86 payments, each its own transaction; purchase #24 refused on chain (mandate_cap_exceeded) after we switched off our own check once to test the chain: https://testnet.metalntwx.com/tx/0x2e92f9cb4549246f58b9b888881c258bf117c6233c1d8f126f4833ae6ae41871
- Visa: Visa Intelligent Commerce through Airwallex's Airi (7 November; Airwallex sandbox, test card; a scripted run, no Claude call; one person played both the CFO and the cardholder): within Purser's limit a purchase was paid with no Purser approval (the cardholder confirmed each purchase in Airi with a passkey); above it PaymentIntent int_sgpvzc9hjhnxvxc26ie succeeded only after the CFO's Face ID; a disallowed merchant was refused by Purser before Airi was asked; 5 of 5 checks: https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-07-vic-1.md
- Claude: three tool-use agents (Sourcing on Claude Haiku, Support on Claude Sonnet, Treasury on Claude Opus) made all 24 decisions in the main run, 0 fallbacks; routine payments are code: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/claude and docs/claude.md
- Claude, measured: 408 decisions in 40 simulated worlds, 10 blind holdouts, each model on each agent, each with its record: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/claude
- Home: one tap on +1 cent changes EUR 240.00 to 240.01 in the owner's real passkey approval of 7 November (its receipt published on 12 November); the visitor's browser re-checks the signature with WebCrypto and refuses, with both hashes shown: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/

## Verify in two minutes

- A test company of your own: Claude reads an invoice, you approve the exact terms with a passkey, then try to change one cent: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try
- Offline, no keys: git clone https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents && cd x402-business-agents && npm ci && npm run judge; then npm run verify-approval checks that real signature of 7 November with Node's own crypto

## Judging criteria and where each is proven

- Airwallex use: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/airwallex (cards per agent with the CFO policy as Airwallex's controls, read back; Airwallex's own declines; SWIFT payouts carrying the signed hash; FX for the shortfall only)
- Agentic: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/claude (three Claude tool-use agents; an agent read Airwallex's decline and asked the CFO for a raise instead of retrying); the replay of the main run of 3 November: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/replay
- Technical: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/proof#guarantees (what Purser guarantees, each with its code, its test and where it ran); docs/controls-matrix.md
- Finance value: https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/tree/main/docs/business (a hypothesis; 2 finance conversations, quoted, anonymous; more in progress; no customers yet)
- Metal: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/metal and docs/metal-award.md; the mandates read live, read-only: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/api/metal/mandates
- T:0: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/t0 (95 journal entries of the main run's books in T:0's sandbox ledger, 10 November, read back with 0 differences)
- Visa: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/visa and docs/runs/2026-11-07-vic-1.md
- After the kit: Airwallex connected accounts live in the sandbox (10 Nov: account acct_SC-QD89fOneAeqaRFgOymw ACTIVE; EUR 5.00 payout a9460dba-f31b-4111-be58-6d9a9e71adb1 with Purser's EUR 0.05 fee accepted by Airwallex, settlement simulated); the SME invoice inbox's code is in this repository (src/ap, src/ledger, src/vault, src/erp, src/payouts, cloud/), tested offline on fakes of Airwallex and Claude; it ran once end to end in the sandbox on 10 Nov for three test companies (1 payout PAID, 3 refused by Airwallex for a missing business registration number; the PAID one EUR 4.84, 593c340b-1752-4537-9ef2-0eb3558897cc, Purser's fee EUR 0.02, as /runs and /airwallex show it); purser Cloud runs publicly as a test preview at purser-try.max-31b.workers.dev/try: test companies, test money on a simulated bank, and its console's Try as guest opens a demo company read-only; the product's own console deployment is another matter: that hosted preview exists but is private (behind an access key), no customer uses it, and it is not ready for real money: docs/after-the-kit.md, docs/runs/2026-11-10-platform-e2e.md

## Key files

- README.md: the submission on one screen, then how it works
- docs/in-depth.md: every live run and every id
- docs/claims.md: every claim and its source
- docs/controls-matrix.md: risk, control, test, evidence
- docs/demo/main-run.json: the main run's record (3 November)
- src/policy/approvals.ts, src/passkey/webauthn.ts: the CFO's signature over the exact terms
- src/policy/cards.ts: the CFO policy as Airwallex card controls
- src/policy/mandates.ts: the Metal mandates
- src/airi/purchase.ts: Visa Intelligent Commerce through Airwallex's Airi
- Connect any AI: Purser Cloud is a remote MCP server at https://purser-try.max-31b.workers.dev/mcp; the demo company's public, read-only token is purser-demo-read-only. Your AI reads and can propose a payment; it can never approve or pay: docs/connect-claude.md
- src/audit/log.ts: the hash-chained audit log

## For agents

- Proof as JSON: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/proof.json. A signed receipt you can check offline: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/receipt-sample.json
- To check a receipt: write the terms as canonical JSON (keys sorted, money as decimal strings); its SHA-256 equals terms_sha256; that hash is the WebAuthn challenge in clientDataJSON; the ES256 signature verifies with public_key. In a clone: npm run verify-receipt -- docs/runs/2026-11-07-awx-1/receipt-P-0002.json
- The sample is the owner's own passkey approval of 7 November (live, Airwallex sandbox, test money; Face ID, as stated by the owner): the receipt does not prove who holds the key, or that it was Face ID (no attestation is checked).
- An outside agent can ask for a company card and pay within limits over MCP (npm run mcp, docs/agent-api.md). Only a person's passkey can approve.
- skills/purser-spend/SKILL.md: how an outside agent should use the agent API
